field_note: Literal translation: "debugging". On a site job: commissioning, i.e. installing, configuring, testing and handing over the robot. A quote for "debugging" reads like a software bug fix; a quote for commissioning is what the customer expects. In software tickets (程序调试 / 软件调试) it does mean debugging.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
field_note: Literal translation: "calibration" (one thing). Several different jobs: sensor extrinsic calibration, camera intrinsics, arm zero calibration (mastering), hand-eye calibration, map alignment to the site. Ask which 标定, what tool it needs and whether it changes taught points.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
field_note: Literal translation: both come out as "stop". 急停 is the emergency stop (a safety function); 停止 / 暂停 is a normal stop or pause. Neither is lockout.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
field_note: Literal translation: "warranty". Maintenance service, often a paid contract. Warranty is 保修 / 质保. Some makers say 免费维保期 (free maintenance period): ask what it covers and whether parts are included.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
field_note: Literal translation: "upgrade". Usually a software update. In a ticket, 升级 can also mean escalation (升级处理). Neither implies a paid upgrade.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
field_note: Literal translation: "reset" (factory reset). Usually clear the fault / reset the alarm. On some arms it means move back to the start position. Factory reset is 恢复出厂设置, and it can wipe maps and settings. Varies by maker, confirm with the maker.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
zh: 回零 vs 零点标定
field_note: Literal translation: both come out as "zeroing". 回零 = homing: move to home. On absolute-encoder arms nothing changes; on incremental-encoder axes (linear modules, external axes, lifts) it also re-finds the home switch and sets the reference. 零点标定 = zero calibration: changes the stored zero; done wrong, every taught point moves. Ask which.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
field_note: Literal translation: "hug brake". Holding brake. On many servo axes it is designed to hold a stopped load, not to stop motion in normal operation. Releasing it on an arm axis or lift top lets gravity act.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
field_note: Literal translation: "body" / "ontology". The robot arm (mechanical unit) as opposed to the controller cabinet. "本体 + 控制柜" = arm + controller.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
field_note: Literal translation: "radar". In robot docs usually lidar (激光雷达). Radio radar is 毫米波雷达.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
field_note: Literal translation: "positioning" / "relocation". For mobile robots: localization / relocalization (finding itself on the map again). Nothing is being moved to a new site.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
field_note: Literal translation: "charging pile". Charging dock / charging station.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
field_note: Literal translation: "upper / lower computer". Host PC software (setup or diagnostic tool on a laptop or IPC) / embedded controller (MCU, drive, robot controller).

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
field_note: Literal translation: "strong / weak electricity". Power wiring / low-voltage, signal and data wiring. On a customer site these are often different trades.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
field_note: Literal translation: "air switch". A circuit breaker (MCB). On site in North America just say "breaker"; see the note in Power and battery about UL 1077 vs UL 489 devices.

category: False friends / 机翻常见坑
en: Contract manufacturer (代工) vs OEM (brand owner)
field_note: Literal translation: "OEM" (read the opposite way). In Chinese, OEM / 代工 usually means making products for another brand. In English service documents, OEM usually means the brand owner or original manufacturer. "Contact the OEM" can point at two different companies: name the company.
